caseNameFull: Harley v. Tehan, U. S. District Judge
attorneys: Sidney M. Eisenberg for petitioner., Gerald J. Kahn for Louisville & Nashville Railroad Co., as amicus curiae, in opposition.

opinions.text: Motion of Louisville & Nashville Railroad Co. for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.
